Name: Bridunow - Daniel - Custom NPC
Author: Bridunow
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/AojLY3L.png[/img]

Hi there! Thank you so much for checking out this mod. 
This Mod adds a whole new NPC to your game named Daniel. He lives near the Busstop with his brother Chase (his mod is a requirement) and their house is a whole new map. He runs a climbing school up on the mountain. Explore his and his brother story! 

Daniel is a bachelor ready for marriage with a full schedule, fully written dialogue and not 5, but 6 full heart events before marriage! (2,4,6,8,9,10 - see details in the spoiler tab). Although his Spouse Room currently doesn't appear, you are able to marry him and he does have a full marriage schedule and marriage dialogue. The rest will be added very soon!

Is fully compatible with SVE, RSV, MM and boarding house 

If you run up against any bugs or problems, please let me know. Although I have playtested extensively, there could be bugs and problems! 
Feel free to message me here, on discord Bridunow#4124 or on twitter @Bridunow

[img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/5/57/Junimo.gif[/img] If you have the Chase mod already installed, please make sure you update it to 1.2.0!  [img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/5/57/Junimo.gif[/img]

[spoiler]
2 heart: Mountain between 6 and 9am, any season/weather
4 heart: Mountain between 8 and 11pm, any season/weather
6 heart: Mountain between 8am and 11pm, any season/weather
8 heart: Mountain between 8am and 11pm, any season/weather
9 heart: Saloon between 12 and 11pm, any season/weather
10 heart: Mountain between 6am and 11pm, any season/weather
[/spoiler]
